Product Specification.notes: Detailed minimum specifications are provided for each device tier in E4, E5, E32, and E33. Warranty requirements are explicitly stated in the specifications and further clarified in E23 and E24. All specifications are minimum requirements that vendors must meet or exceed.

Installation.value: Deployment services required, including software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. For Windows devices, autopilot enrollment is required. For Chromebooks, enrollment in Google Management is required. All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services including asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations. Etching required on laptops only (not on monitors or desktop computers). Asset tagging and etching are both required. Repair and warranty service must be performed at no cost within 5 business days of the District reporting an issue.

Installation.notes: E4 specifies deployment services must include asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery. E22 requires detailed plans for deployment services. E21 (Addendum) clarifies that for Windows devices autopilot enrollment is required, and for Chromebooks Google Management enrollment is required. E37 clarifies etching is required on laptops only, and both asset tagging and etching are required. E34 specifies warranty service and repair must be performed at no cost within 5 business days.

Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (contact: Sherri Williams, shewilli@dallasisd.org) is seeking bids for computing devices including 50,000 Tier 1 Small Student Chromebooks, 50,000 Tier 2 Large Student Chromebooks, 5,000 Tier 3 Student Windows Laptops, 50,000 Student Tablets, 5,000 Tier 1 Staff Basic Desktops, 5,000 Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktops, 10,000 Tier 1 Staff Laptops, 10,000 Tier 2 Staff Laptops, 5,000 Touch Display Monitors, and 5,000 Non-Touch Display Monitors with detailed specifications for each. Proposals must be submitted electronically via iSupplier portal or via sealed envelope to Dallas ISD Procurement Services by July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST. The contract includes a three-year initial term with two successive one-year renewal options, not to exceed five years total. Required documentation includes MWBE Forms, W9 Form, Form 1295 Certificate of Interested Parties, Certificate of Insurance/Bond (within 10 days of award), and acknowledgments of Addendum 1 and Addendum 2. Deployment services are required including software installation, asset tagging and etching, white glove service, and 5-day warranty repair service at no cost, with Addendum 2 extending the original due date.
